title: Software Engineer (Commodities Data Team)
description:
DRW are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Commodities trading group to build data pipelines for the ingestion and analysis of datasets. The role entails working closely with senior data engineers and key stakeholders across both green field and established projects. Initially it will be focused on getting data to our analysts, with  opportunities to help design and build the core data infrastructure used across the group as your experience grows.

How you will make an impact…

  • Development of reliable ETL pipelines in Python
  • Work on a small team alongside experienced engineers
  • Regular direct contact with internal users
  • Contribute to a mixture of both legacy and greenfield projects

What you bring to the team…

  • A bachelor’s or master’s in a numeric degree or related field
  • Python programming experience
  • Enthusiastic, motivated, and detail-oriented
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world.  We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk. 

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

title: Avionics Software Engineer
description:
About Lodestar

Lodestar's mission is to develop the first "Protect and Defend" capability for high-value space assets in orbit. Our flagship product, MITHRIL, is our hardware-agnostic, AI-enabled autonomy software suite that enables us to augment any off-the-shelf spacecraft with the ability to autonomously detect, characterise, and reversibly neutralise orbital threats. By building on the proven space heritage of our best-in-class satellite-bus partners and fully integrating MITHRIL into a single unified platform, we deliver an end-to-end, autonomous in-space bodyguarding service.

About the Job

We’re hiring Avionics Software Engineers across three technical focus areas: Flight Software, Distributed Middleware & Embedded Linux Depending on your experience, you’ll take ownership of one of these areas while working closely across avionics, autonomy, AI/ML, and hardware. 

What You'll Do

Within our Avionics Software team, we're hiring multiple engineers across three core technical specialisms. Please identify which role best matches your skills and experience: 

1. Flight Software Engineering

  • Design and develop deterministic, safety-critical, fault tolerant flight software for autonomous spacecraft.
  • Build robust software for RTOS-based flight computers, implementing FDIR and defensive programming techniques.
  • Collaborate with autonomy, AI, and hardware engineers to integrate, test, and validate mission-critical software on representative spacecraft platforms.

  • Develop the distributed middleware enabling communication, workload orchestration, and telemetry across heterogeneous onboard compute systems.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:

 We are champions of rail, inspired to build a greener, more sustainable future of travel. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.
 Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄

 Introducing the Trainline International Supply Team 👋
Trainline exists to make rail and coach travel easier for millions of customers across Europe - and the International Supply team is at the heart of making that possible. We work at the intersection of commercial partnerships, technical integrations, and customer experience, bringing new carriers and markets to life on the Trainline platform. The work we do shapes how customers across the continent discover, book, and travel - and there is plenty more to build.
As a Senior Product Manager in this team, you will own the end-to-end journey of bringing new markets onto the platform - from understanding the underlying customer problem through to how a new carrier or market shows up in the experience. You will work across two squads, going deep where it matters most, and collaborating closely with Engineering, Design, Commercial, Legal, Finance, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver real impact at scale.

title: Physician - Clinical AI Expert (Remote)
description:
We are seeking physicians to review, validate and design clinical tasks to help advance frontier AI models across a range of clinical scenarios and formats.
 The project is designed to surface where models perform poorly in clinical scenarios such missed findings, incorrect clinical information, overconfidence or failure to seek context before answering.
 You will work asynchronously on a dedicated platform, within your own specialty and day-to-day scope of practice.
 This is a remote, flexible and short-term project.
 Key Responsibilities
 Scenario Design: Design realistic clinical scenarios and instructions that mirror the work you carry out day-to-day in your specialty.
 Content Review: Assess clinical outputs for accuracy, flagging anything incorrect, outdated or can cause harm.
 Reference Answer Validation: Judge whether reference answers reflect what you would actually write in practice, including caveats, uncertainty and requests for further information.
 Grading Criteria Assessment: Design and evaluate whether scoring criteria capture what matters clinically and whether each is weighted appropriately, particularly safety-critical items.
 Written Rationale: Provide short, specific reasoning where you disagree, and note the weakness each new item is designed to expose.
 Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Highlight edge cases and ambiguity to refine guidelines and improve consistency across reviewers.
Qualifications Licensure: Registered doctor based in the US, Europe or Asia-Pacific.
 Experience: Current or recent clinical practice in your stated specialty.
 Knowledge: Strong grounding in current guidelines, diagnostic reasoning and clinical documentation standards.
 Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in clinical review or assessment work.
 Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured review tools and digital platforms.
 Language: Native or near-native written English.

title: Sports Trader
description:

 We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.
